limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the two balance transitions but also counted simultaneous inputs together instead of giving d1 priority, accepted new credit during vending, and replaced the original state-decoded change output with queued, clock-dependent pulses.
The rewrite kept the module name and ports but removed the original public state parameters, so an instantiation that overrides them would no longer compile.

limitations.quote: // Simultaneous coins produce two half-yuan change pulses.
limitations.note: The passing test covered the two bad transitions, but it treated the rewrite’s simultaneous-credit and queued-change behavior as expected rather than checking that the original coin priority and output timing were preserved.
